data.name: TokenWindowTitle
data.comment: Title of the window that asks for a Todoist API token on first launch.

data.name: TokenHeading
data.comment: Bold heading in the token window, above the explanation.

data.name: TokenExplanation
data.value: Termyn reads your tasks with your Todoist API token. It's kept in your Keychain and only ever sent to Todoist.
data.comment: Explains what the token is for and where it's kept, under the token window's heading.

data.name: TokenPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the empty field the token is pasted into.

data.name: TokenWhere
data.comment: Link in the token window that opens Todoist's integration settings, where the API token is shown.

data.name: TokenConnect
data.comment: Default button in the token window: checks the token with Todoist and stores it.

data.name: TokenRejected
data.value: Todoist didn't accept that token. Check it was copied in full.
data.comment: Shown under the token field when Todoist turns the token away.

data.name: TokenUnreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach Todoist. Check your connection and try again.
data.comment: Shown under the token field when Todoist couldn't be reached to check the token.

data.name: TokenSaveFailed
data.value: The token couldn't be saved to your Keychain. Try again.
data.comment: Shown under the token field when Todoist accepted the token but the Keychain wouldn't store it.

data.name: NoTasks
data.comment: Centred in the task list when the selected view has nothing in it. Title case, as macOS writes empty-state titles.

data.name: UnreadableFilter
data.comment: Centred in the task list when a saved filter uses something Termyn can't evaluate. {0} is the filter's query as written in Todoist.

data.name: UnreadableFilterLink
data.comment: Button under the unreadable-filter notice that opens the filter in Todoist's web app.

data.name: ReconnectNeeded
data.value: Todoist turned the saved token away, so nothing is syncing and nothing can be changed until it's reconnected.
data.comment: Banner above the task list when Todoist has rejected the stored token. The tasks below are still shown from the local copy.

data.name: SyncFailed
data.comment: Window subtitle when a sync fails for a reason other than being offline. {0} is the error's own message.

data.name: Completed
data.comment: Read out by VoiceOver for the filled circle in front of a completed task.

data.name: CommentCount
data.comment: Read out by VoiceOver for the comment mark on a task row. {0} is how many comments it has.

data.name: ToolbarSync
data.comment: Label of the toolbar button that syncs with Todoist now.

data.name: ToolbarSyncTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the toolbar button that syncs with Todoist now.

data.name: MenuAbout
data.comment: Application menu item that opens the About panel.

data.name: MenuSettings
data.comment: Application menu item for the Settings window, which doesn't exist yet, so the item is disabled.

data.name: MenuServices
data.comment: Application menu's Services submenu, filled in by macOS.

data.name: MenuHide
data.comment: Application menu item that hides the app.

data.name: MenuHideOthers
data.comment: Application menu item that hides every other app.

data.name: MenuShowAll
data.comment: Application menu item that shows every hidden app.

data.name: MenuQuit
data.comment: Application menu item that quits the app.

data.name: MenuFile
data.comment: Title of the File menu.

data.name: MenuClose
data.comment: File menu item that closes the front window.

data.name: MenuEdit
data.comment: Title of the Edit menu.

data.name: MenuUndo
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuRedo
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuCut
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuCopy
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuPaste
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuSelectAll
data.comment: Edit menu item.

data.name: MenuView
data.comment: Title of the View menu.

data.name: MenuToday
data.comment: View menu item that shows the Today view, the same as picking it in the sidebar.

data.name: MenuUpcoming
data.comment: View menu item that shows the Upcoming view, the same as picking it in the sidebar.

data.name: MenuInbox
data.comment: View menu item that shows the Inbox, the same as picking it in the sidebar.

data.name: MenuSyncNow
data.comment: View menu item that syncs with Todoist straight away.

data.name: MenuShowSidebar
data.comment: View menu item that shows or hides the sidebar. macOS switches it to "Hide Sidebar" while the sidebar is showing.

data.name: MenuWindow
data.comment: Title of the Window menu.

data.name: MenuMinimize
data.comment: Window menu item.

data.name: MenuZoom
data.comment: Window menu item.

data.name: MenuBringAllToFront
data.comment: Window menu item.

data.name: MenuHelp
data.comment: Title of the Help menu.

data.name: MenuProjectPage
data.comment: Help menu item that opens Termyn's project page.

data.name: MenuNewTask
data.comment: File menu item and toolbar label: opens the box for adding a task.

data.name: MenuTask
data.comment: Title of the Task menu, which holds what can be done to the selected task.

data.name: MarkCompleted
data.comment: Task menu item that ticks the selected task off. Reminders' wording for the same action.

data.name: MarkIncomplete
data.comment: Task menu item that puts a ticked-off task back. Reminders' wording for the same action.

data.name: Rename
data.comment: Task menu item that edits the selected task's name in place.

data.name: DueDate
data.comment: Task menu item that opens the due-date popover for the selected task.

data.name: MenuSchedule
data.comment: Task submenu with the days a task can be put on at a click.

data.name: DueToday
data.comment: Schedule submenu item and due-date button: due today.

data.name: DueTomorrow
data.comment: Schedule submenu item and due-date button: due tomorrow.

data.name: DueWeekend
data.comment: Schedule submenu item and due-date button: due on the day the account's weekend starts.

data.name: DueNextWeek
data.comment: Schedule submenu item and due-date button: due on the day the account calls next week.

data.name: DueNone
data.comment: Schedule submenu item and due-date button: takes the due date off.

data.name: MenuPriority
data.comment: Task submenu with the four priorities.

data.name: PriorityN
data.comment: Priority submenu item. {0} is 1 to 4, 1 being the highest, as Todoist numbers them.

data.name: ShowInTodoist
data.comment: Task menu item that opens the selected task in Todoist's web app.

data.name: Delete
data.comment: Task menu item that deletes the selected task. Not confirmed: Undo brings it back.

data.name: NothingToUndo
data.comment: Window subtitle when Undo is pressed with nothing it can take back.

data.name: ShowInTodoistNotYet
data.value: This task hasn't reached Todoist yet.
data.comment: Window subtitle when Show in Todoist is asked for a task that hasn't been synced, so Todoist has no page for it.

data.name: ChangeFailed
data.comment: Window subtitle when a change to a task couldn't be made here. {0} is the error's own message.

data.name: NewTaskTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the toolbar button that opens the box for adding a task.

data.name: FailedOne
data.comment: Banner above the task list when Todoist refused one change for good.

data.name: FailedMany
data.comment: Banner above the task list when Todoist refused several changes for good. {0} is how many.

data.name: FailedReview
data.comment: Button in the banner about refused changes; opens the list of them.

data.name: FailedTitle
data.comment: Heading of the sheet that lists the changes Todoist refused.

data.name: FailedDismiss
data.comment: Button beside a refused change: forgets it, putting the task back the way Todoist has it.

data.name: Done
data.comment: Button that closes the sheet listing refused changes.

data.name: TokenOutOfReach
data.value: Waiting to read the Todoist token from your Keychain…
data.comment: Window subtitle while the token is stored but can't be read yet: the Keychain is locked or its access prompt hasn't been answered. Syncing carries on by itself once it can.

data.name: ReconnectButton
data.comment: Button in the banner shown when Todoist has turned the saved token away; asks for a new one.

data.name: MenuReconnect
data.comment: Application menu item that asks for a new token. Enabled only while Todoist has turned the saved one away.

data.name: ReconnectHeading
data.comment: Bold heading of the sheet that asks for a new token after Todoist turned the saved one away.

data.name: ReconnectExplanation
data.value: Todoist turned the saved token away, which happens when it's been regenerated. Paste the current one to carry on; anything changed meanwhile is sent once it's accepted.
data.comment: Explains why a new token is being asked for, under the reconnect sheet's heading.

data.name: Cancel
data.comment: Button that gives up on reconnecting, or on switching account.

data.name: SwitchAccountTitle
data.value: Switch to a different Todoist account?
data.comment: Heading of the question asked when a pasted token belongs to a different account from the one held.

data.name: SwitchAccount
data.comment: Button that forgets this account's local copy and goes on with the other account's token.

data.name: SwitchAccountFailed
data.value: Termyn couldn't switch accounts, so the last account is still held.
data.comment: Heading of the alert when switching account couldn't finish. The error itself follows.
